user.title: Steam Tracker
user.description: Add one Steam account using its 17-digit SteamID64. Steam verifies the API key and account before saving. Add more accounts as separate services and choose a distinct name for each.

reconfigure.title: Change Steam Web API key
reconfigure.description: Enter a new Steam Web API key for {name}. The key is saved after Steam confirms access to this account.

reauth_confirm.title: Restore Steam access
reauth_confirm.description: Steam denied player-summary access for {name}. Enter a working Steam Web API key for this account.

abort.already_configured: This Steam account is already configured.
abort.missing_import_data: The imported configuration is missing the Steam User ID or Web API key.
abort.invalid_auth: Steam rejected the Web API key or denied access. Check the key and Steam access permissions.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Steam. Try again later.
abort.invalid_response: Steam returned an unreadable or inconsistent response. Try again later.
abort.account_not_found: Steam returned no account for this SteamID64. Check the ID.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The Steam account does not match the existing configuration.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The Steam Web API key was updated.
